posts.title: A map of San Mateo’s bike islands
posts.description: San Mateo and Burlingame are full of quiet streets, many of which don't connect. A new map shows each island and the crossings that would join them.

posts.title: In the US, trains carry freight. In Japan, they carry people.
posts.description: The average American travels about 45 miles a year by train; the average person in Japan, about 1,750. The gap opened when the US let its railroads stop carrying people.

posts.title: Small acts
posts.description: One request to my city took 2 years and 9 months, another under 6 months. How a crosswalk and bike racks got done, and a 6-step playbook for asking a city to fix something small.
